title: Asian Caramelized Chicken and Zucchini

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched

steps: Start the rice in a pot of boiling water and cook it as the package says.
Warm the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add the zucchini (diced), onion (sliced) and garlic (minced) and cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce, brown sugar and a splash of water. Leave it alone until it turns sticky and glossy.
Stir, add the chicken in thin strips and cook about 5 minutes until no pink is left. Season.
Serve over the drained rice.

title: Bagel with Tofu and Cucumber

lines.food: Plant-based soft cream cheese alternative, almond-based, vegan
Bagels, plain, enriched, with calcium propionate (includes onion, poppy, sesame)

steps: Split the bagel and toast it if you like.
Spread the vegan cream cheese on both halves.
Layer on sliced cucumber and the smoked tofu, then close it or eat it open.

title: Baked Pork Chop with Butternut Squash

lines.food: Pork, fresh, loin, center loin (chops), boneless, separable lean only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tray with parchment.
Coat the pork chop with mustard and thyme. Toss the squash cubes with the oil, salt and pepper.
Put both on the tray and roast 20 to 25 minutes, turning the chop once, until the pork is cooked and the squash is soft and browned.

title: Banana Cocoa Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Plant-based yogurt alternative, made from soya, unsweetened

steps: Put everything in a blender (a frozen banana makes it thicker; otherwise add a couple of ice cubes).
Blend until smooth, thinning with a little water if needed, and drink right away.

title: Banana Matcha Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend the milk, protein powder, matcha and banana until smooth (frozen banana or ice for a colder shake).
Pour into a glass and scatter the sliced almonds on top.

title: Basque-Style Chicken with Pasta and Piperade

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Boil the pasta, drain and keep warm.
Slice the onion, garlic and pepper into strips; dice the tomato.
Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil, add the pepper and cook 10 minutes. Add the tomato, season and simmer 5 minutes.
In another pan, cook the chicken in the rest of the oil, 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Spoon the pepper sauce over the chicken, simmer 2 minutes together and serve on the pasta.

title: Beef and Cheddar Avocado Rolls
steps: Lay the roast beef slices flat and brush each with a little mustard.
Put spinach, avocado slices and cheddar at one end of each slice.
Roll up tightly; use a toothpick if they won't stay closed.

title: Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Sesame Seeds

lines.food: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Blanch the broccoli in boiling water 3 to 4 minutes and drain.
Brown the beef in the oil in a hot nonstick pan.
Add the garlic, soy sauce and broccoli and toss over high heat for a minute.
Finish with the sesame seeds.

title: Beef Taco-Style Lettuce Wraps

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 70 g (2.5 oz) canned red kidney beans, drained
lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Brown the beef in the oil over medium heat, 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the taco seasoning for a minute, then the corn and beans until hot.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with diced tomato and a spoon of Greek yogurt.

title: Beef with Garlic Potatoes and Green Beans

lines.food: Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw

steps: Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
Heat the oil with the garlic in a large nonstick pan, add the potatoes and cook about 10 minutes, stirring.
Push the potatoes aside and add the steak and green beans. Cook the steak 3 to 4 minutes a side, stirring the vegetables now and then.
Season with salt, pepper, herbs and a squeeze of lemon, and serve.

title: Plant-Based Blanquette with Sweet Potato

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Dice the onion and sweet potato, slice the carrot and mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in a nonstick pot and set aside. Cook the onion, carrot, sweet potato and plant-based chunks in the oil for 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the broth cube dissolved in the water and the bouquet garni. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, adding water if it gets dry.
Stir the flour into the sour cream, add to the pot and stir until it thickens. Return the mushrooms, simmer 5 minutes and season.

title: Bowl Cake with a Melting Jam Center

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Beat the eggs and milk in a microwave-safe bowl.
Mix in the oats and baking powder.
Press the jam into the middle of the batter.
Microwave about 2 minutes. Eat warm or cold.

title: Buckwheat Galette with Smoked Salmon

lines.t: 2 tbsp lactose-free light sour cream (30 g)

lines.food: Buckwheat crepe, plain, to be filled, prepacked

steps: Stir the lemon juice into the sour cream.
Warm the galette in a nonstick pan 2 to 3 minutes and set it aside.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Spread the lemon cream on the galette, add the eggs and smoked salmon, season, add dill and fold.

title: Buckwheat Galette Wrap with Creamy Salmon

lines.food: Buckwheat crepe, plain, to be filled, prepacked

steps: Mix the yogurt with the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread it over the galettes.
Add grated carrot and the smoked salmon, season, roll up tightly and serve.

title: Buckwheat Wrap with Turkey and Avocado

lines.food: Buckwheat crepe, plain, to be filled, prepacked

steps: Spread hummus over the crêpes.
Add the turkey and sliced avocado, season.
Roll up tightly and serve.

title: Chaffle
steps: Beat the egg and stir in the grated cheddar, herbs, salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot waffle iron 3 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Eat hot or cold; they keep well for later.

title: Chia Pudding with Jam

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Stir the chia seeds, milk, yogurt and honey together in a jar until there are no clumps.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours.
Spoon the jam on top before eating.

title: Chicken and Asparagus Risotto

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Dissolve the broth cube in about 2 cups of hot water and keep it warm.
Cut the asparagus into short pieces.
Toast the rice in the oil until it looks glassy, then add the asparagus.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, letting each one soak in before the next.
Halfway through, stir in the chicken in small cubes so it cooks with the rice.
When the rice is creamy and tender, top with the Parmesan and serve.

title: Chicken Pasta Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the pasta, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Cook the diced chicken in the oil until done, 6 to 8 minutes.
Whisk the mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes, diced Emmental and chicken, then pour on the dressing.

title: Chickpea Cookie Dough

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Blitz the oats in a food processor until floury.
Add the chickpeas, honey, peanut butter, vanilla, a pinch of salt and some of the milk.
Blend to a smooth dough, adding milk a little at a time if needed.
Fold in the chocolate chips.

title: Chickpea Omelette with Hummus and Tomatoes

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, garlic powder, water and oil into a smooth batter.
Pour into a hot nonstick pan, spread it out and lower the heat.
When the edges firm up, flip and cook until set.
Top with hummus, halved cherry tomatoes and parsley.

title: Chickpea Salad with Mushrooms and Soft-Boiled Eggs

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

steps: Boil the eggs 6 minutes, then cool them in ice water.
Cut the endive into strips and slice the mushrooms thinly.
Add the drained chickpeas and chopped walnuts.
Whisk the vinegar and oil with salt and pepper, toss with the salad and top with the halved eggs.

title: Chili Sin Carne

lines.t: 55 g (2 oz) canned red kidney beans, drained
lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Cook the rice until tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Brown the rehydrated TVP in a nonstick pan, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, paprika, corn and beans and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Season.
Serve over the rice with cilantro.

title: Chocolate and Red Bean Brownie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

lines.t: 55 g (2 oz) cooked red kidney beans
lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

steps: Rinse and drain the beans.
Blend the beans, cocoa, honey and milk until completely smooth.
Pour into a ramekin and top with chopped walnuts.
Microwave 1½ to 2 minutes (or bake about 15 minutes at 350°F / 175°C). Let cool a little.

title: Chocolate Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything with an ice cube or two until smooth.
Add a little water if it's too thick and drink right away.

title: Cloud Bread Ham and Cheese Sandwich
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a tray.
Separate the eggs. Beat the whites to stiff peaks.
Mix the yolks with the cream cheese and a pinch of salt, then gently fold into the whites.
Spoon into two rounds and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Once cool, fill with the ham and cheddar.

title: Coconut Mango Quinoa Porridge

lines.food: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Rinse the quinoa.
Simmer it in the milk over low heat 12 to 15 minutes until creamy, adding a splash of liquid if needed.
Sweeten with the honey, top with diced mango and coconut. Warm or cold.

title: Coconut Rice with Chicken and Green Beans

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

steps: Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and pepper and coat the chicken cubes (marinate a couple of hours if you can).
Bake the chicken on a lined tray at 350°F (180°C) about 10 minutes, until golden and cooked.
Rinse the rice, then bring it to a boil with the coconut milk, the same amount of water, the honey and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on low 15 minutes, then let it rest.
Warm the green beans in a pan and serve everything together.

title: Cottage Cheese and Applesauce
steps: Spoon the applesauce into a glass or jar.
Add the cottage cheese on top.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

title: Creamy Chicken and Pea Pasta

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Peas, green, frozen, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Soften the sliced onion in the oil, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and chicken and cook through, 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream, lemon juice and peas until hot.
Toss in the drained pasta, the dill and some lemon zest.

title: Creamy Curry Pasta with Ground Beef

lines.food: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Cook the pasta with the broccoli florets 8 to 10 minutes and drain.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil until golden, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the beef and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in the pasta, broccoli, sour cream and curry powder, season, and simmer 2 to 3 minutes with a splash of water.

title: Creamy Tuna Bowl with Wasa Crispbread

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 100 g (3.5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Mix the yogurt, drained tuna and mustard.
Fold in quartered cherry tomatoes and diced cucumber; season.
Top with parsley and the almonds and eat with the crispbreads.

title: Seared Duck with Roasted Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 390°F (200°C).
Toss the sweet potato cubes, sliced onion and mushrooms, garlic and thyme with the olive oil on a lined tray. Season.
Roast about 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sweet potato is soft and crisp at the edges.
At the end, sear the duck strips in a hot nonstick pan, about 2 minutes a side. Season and serve with the vegetables.

title: Easy Tuna and Parmesan Wrap

lines.t: 200 g (7 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Drain and flake the tuna.
Mix in diced cucumber, chopped red onion, the yogurt and Parmesan.
Lay lettuce on the tortillas, spoon the tuna over and roll up tightly.

title: English Muffin Egg-Bacon
steps: Split and toast the muffin.
Crisp the bacon in a nonstick pan and set it aside.
Scramble the egg in the same pan and season.
Fill the muffin with the cheese, egg and bacon.

title: Fish Skewers with Tomato, Olives, and Basil

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cut the fish into 1-inch cubes and thread onto skewers (or leave loose).
Brown the fish in the oil over medium-high heat, 3 to 4 minutes, and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the tomatoes, olives, lemon juice, garlic powder and basil 4 to 6 minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Put the fish back in, toss gently and serve.

title: Garlic Tomato Cod with Quinoa

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the quinoa about 10 minutes until tender and drain.
Chop the garlic, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Pat the fish dry and season it.
Cook the garlic and tomatoes in the oil for a few minutes, then add the fish and cook 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Serve with the quinoa and parsley.

title: Greek Yogurt with Honey
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and drizzle with the honey or agave.

title: Green Quinoa with Chicken

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Cook the quinoa with the broccoli florets in boiling water 12 to 15 minutes and drain.
Brown the chicken pieces in the oil, 6 to 8 minutes, until cooked.
Steam or boil the green beans until tender.
Mix the sour cream with the pesto.
Plate the quinoa, broccoli and beans, add the chicken and spoon the pesto cream over.

title: Green Spinach and Grape Smoothie

lines.food: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw

steps: Put the grapes, banana, spinach, chia, water and a few ice cubes in a blender.
Add the protein powder and yogurt.
Blend until smooth, adding water if needed.

title: Grilled Chicken and Hummus Wrap

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Cook the sliced chicken in a nonstick pan until done, 6 to 8 minutes.
Spread hummus on the tortilla, leaving a border.
Add lettuce, grated carrot and the chicken, a spoon of yogurt and the Parmesan. Season.
Fold in the sides, roll up and cut in half. Eat cold or warm it in a pan.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken with Quinoa

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in water with the broth cube, covered, until the liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
Slice the zucchini and brown it in a little of the oil. Season and set aside.
Mix the mustard and honey (a splash of water if it's thick).
Cook the chicken in the rest of the oil 6 to 8 minutes a side, brushing on the honey mustard near the end.
Serve with the quinoa and zucchini.

title: Air-Dried Beef and Cheese Crispbreads

lines.food: Viande des Grisons or dried beef meat

lines.t: 3 tbsp cancoillotte (or light cheese spread) (45 g)

steps: Spread the cheese over the crispbreads.
Lay the dried beef on top.

title: Ground Beef Stuffed Bell Pepper

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the top off the pepper, scoop out the seeds and stand it in a small oiled dish.
Soften the onion in the olive oil, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then brown the beef.
Stir in the cooked rice, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste and paprika, season and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.
Pack the filling into the pepper, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover, add the cheese and bake 8 to 10 minutes more until melted.

title: Ham and Cheese Rolls
steps: Spread cream cheese over each slice of ham.
Roll each one up tightly.

title: Herb and Feta Omelet

lines.food: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D

steps: Chop the herbs.
Beat the eggs with the milk, herbs, salt and pepper.
Pour into the hot olive oil in a nonstick pan and let it set 2 to 3 minutes without stirring.
Crumble the feta over, fold the omelet and give it one more minute.

title: High-Protein Chicken, Egg and Spinach Bagel

lines.food: Bagels, plain, enriched, with calcium propionate (includes onion, poppy, sesame)

steps: Hard-boil the eggs (10 minutes), cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Split and toast the bagel, then spread both halves with the goat cheese and season.
Layer spinach, chicken and egg slices on the bottom half and close.

title: High-Protein Crêpes with Jam

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Beat the eggs with the skyr.
Whisk in the flour, milk, baking powder and a pinch of salt until smooth. Rest 10 minutes.
Wipe a nonstick pan with the oil, pour in a ladle of batter and swirl it thin.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden. Repeat, and serve with the jam.

title: Hummus and Tuna Sandwich

lines.t: 140 g (5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Toast the bread if you like. Grate the carrot and chop the olives.
Mix the hummus, drained tuna, olives and a spice you like.
Spread on one slice, add the carrot and close the sandwich.

title: Mackerel and Celeriac Salad

lines.food: Plant-based yogurt alternative, made from soya, unsweetened

steps: Whisk the yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Grate the celery (or celeriac) and coat it in the dressing.
Flake the mackerel over the top, then add walnuts and parsley just before eating.

title: Marinated Seitan and Potatoes
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, oil, vinegar, honey and garlic. Add the seitan pieces and marinate (an hour if you can).
Boil the potatoes until tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Brown the seitan in a hot nonstick pan, 5 to 7 minutes.
Serve with the potatoes and salad, with the leftover marinade spooned over.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Chickpea Salad

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Slice the chicken into strips and cook in the oil 6 to 8 minutes until done. Season.
Whisk the vinegar and lemon juice with salt and pepper.
Combine halved tomatoes, diced red onion, parsley, chickpeas and the chicken.
Pour on the dressing, toss, and let it sit a few minutes before eating.

title: Mediterranean Tuna and Quinoa Salad

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 140 g (5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids
Beans, snap, green, canned, regular pack, drained solids

steps: Cook the quinoa in salted water 8 to 10 minutes, then rinse cold and drain well.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and mustard.
Combine the quinoa, green beans, chopped onion and tomato, tuna, olives and dill.
Dress, season, toss and serve.

title: Baked Chicken with Polenta and Ratatouille

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Plant-based cheese alternative, vegetable fat based, vegan

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Dice the zucchini and tomato and cook in part of the oil with salt and pepper, then simmer 15 minutes.
Put the chicken in a baking dish, rub with the rest of the oil, season and bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Bring the water to a boil, whisk in the polenta and stir over low heat until thick. Stir in the cheese and season.
Serve the polenta with the chicken and vegetables.

title: Pasta with Seitan and Leeks with Emmental

lines.food: Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)

steps: Cook the pasta and drain.
Warm the oil, add the garlic for a minute, then the sliced leeks. Cook until soft, adding a splash of water if they catch.
Add the diced seitan and brown it.
Stir in the pasta and cream, season, and top with the cheese.

title: Pink Hard-Boiled Egg
steps: Hard-boil the eggs 9 to 10 minutes, cool and peel.
Blend the beet with the vinegar and enough water to cover the eggs.
Sit the eggs in the pink liquid in the fridge for at least an hour (overnight for deeper color).

title: Pork with Mustard and Tomato Gnocchi

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 29 ml (1 fl oz) light sour cream

lines.food: Pork, fresh, loin, tenderloin, separable lean only, raw

steps: Halve the tomatoes and slice the onion. Brush the pork with mustard and season.
Soften the onion in the oil 3 to 4 minutes, add the tomatoes for 2 to 3 minutes, then the gnocchi and sour cream.
Heat through 3 to 4 minutes, season and plate.
In the same pan, sear the pork 2 minutes a side and serve alongside.

title: Protein Banana Oat Smoothie

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything (frozen banana works best) until smooth, adding water if it's too thick.

title: Protein Cheesecake with Red Berries

lines.food: Plant-based yogurt alternative, made from soya, unsweetened

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Whisk the yogurt, cornstarch, eggs and honey until smooth.
Fold in the berries and pour into a small baking dish.
Bake about 20 minutes, then chill at least 2 hours.

title: Protein Fruity Ice Cream with Cottage Cheese
steps: Blend the frozen fruit, cottage cheese and honey until smooth.
Freeze in a container for at least 2 hours.
If it turns icy, blend again just before serving.

title: Protein Oat Pancakes

lines.t: 50 ml (1.75 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

steps: Mix everything except the maple syrup into a batter; add milk until it pours slowly.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan, then lower the heat.
Cook small pancakes about 2 minutes, flip and give them 1 more.
Drizzle with the maple syrup.

title: Overnight Porridge with Pear and Chocolate

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Mix the milk, oats, protein powder and honey in a jar.
Chill at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with diced pear, almonds and chocolate chips. Loosen with water, or warm it if you prefer.

title: Protein Yogurt with Granola and Fruits
steps: Cut the fruit into pieces.
Stir the honey and protein powder into the yogurt.
Top with the granola and fruit.

title: Protein-Rich Hazelnut Skyr Parfait

lines.food: Cereals ready-to-eat, WEETABIX whole grain cereal
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Crumble the Weetabix into a container, pour over half the milk and mash into a base.
Mix the skyr with the protein powder and spread it over.
Melt the chocolate (30 to 60 seconds in the microwave), stir in the rest of the milk and the crushed hazelnuts, and spread on top.
Chill a few hours.

title: Quinoa Chicken Salad with Cranberries and Feta

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Cook the quinoa 12 to 15 minutes, then rinse cold and drain. Cook the chicken in the oil 6 to 8 minutes a side.
Combine lettuce, diced cucumber and cranberries with the quinoa.
Slice the chicken and add it with the crumbled feta.
Whisk the vinegar and lemon juice, toss everything and season.

title: Quinoa with Mushrooms and Chicken

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)

steps: Cook the quinoa.
Cook the garlic and sliced mushrooms in the oil and season.
Push the mushrooms aside and cook the chicken in the same pan until golden and done.
Stir the cream into the mushrooms for 2 minutes and spoon over the quinoa and chicken.

title: Refreshing Tuna and Red Bean Salad

lines.t: 28 g (1 oz) canned red kidney beans, drained
lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

lines.t: 140 g (5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Combine the lettuce, beans, flaked tuna and corn.
Add chopped red onion and avocado.
Mix the yogurt with lemon juice, salt and pepper, pour over and finish with cilantro.

title: Rice Paper Egg Galette
steps: Beat the eggs with chives, salt and pepper.
Heat a little oil in a nonstick pan on low. Lay a dry rice paper sheet in the pan.
Pour the eggs over it right away and spread them to the edges.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes until crisp underneath and set on top. Add the cheese and fold.
Serve with the salad dressed in lemon juice and the rest of the oil.

title: Roasted Chicken Thigh with Potatoes and Carrots

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks and put them in a dish with the crushed garlic.
Toss with half the oil, thyme, salt and pepper.
Mix the rest of the oil with the mustard, brush it over the chicken, season and set it on the vegetables.
Roast 40 to 45 minutes, stirring the vegetables halfway, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.

title: Savory Crêpes with Plant-Based Ham and Hummus

lines.t: 120 ml (4 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

steps: Stir the flaxseeds into a few spoons of water and warm a few seconds to thicken (a flax egg).
Whisk the oat flour, flax egg, milk and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Cook ¼-cup portions in a hot nonstick pan until the edges lift, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Spread with hummus, add the plant-based ham and fold.

title: Savory Ham and Emmental Pancakes

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Beat the egg, then whisk in the flour.
Add the water a little at a time until smooth and thick.
Stir in the cheese and diced ham.
Cook small spoonfuls in a lightly oiled pan 1 to 2 minutes a side.

title: Savory Vegan Ham Madeleines

lines.food: Tofu, soft, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
Plant-based cheese alternative, vegetable fat based, vegan

lines.t: 15 ml (1/2 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and grease a madeleine or mini-muffin tray with the margarine.
Dice the plant-based ham.
Mix the flour and baking powder, then whisk in the tofu, oil and milk until smooth.
Fold in the ham, cheese, herbs and pepper and fill the molds three-quarters full.
Bake 4 minutes, then lower to 350°F (180°C) and bake 4 to 6 minutes more until golden.

title: Savory Vegan Ham Pancakes

lines.food: Tofu, soft, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
Plant-based cheese alternative, vegetable fat based, vegan

lines.t: 165 ml (5.5 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Whisk the milk and silken tofu into the flour until smooth and fairly thick (add water if needed).
Stir in the cheese and chopped plant-based ham.
Cook small ladlefuls in a lightly oiled pan 1 to 2 minutes a side.

title: Savory Pancakes with Smoked Salmon

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
Whisk in the egg and milk.
Cook small pancakes in a nonstick pan 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Top with sour cream, smoked salmon and chives.

title: Savory Skyr with Olives and Walnuts

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Mix the skyr with chopped olives, walnuts and dill. Season.
Eat with the bread, toasted if you like.

title: Savory Spinach Waffles

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Heat the waffle iron and brush it with a little oil if it sticks.
Chop the spinach and mix it with everything else into a thick batter.
Cook 3 to 5 minutes until the waffles lift out easily. Eat hot or keep for later.

title: Scrambled Tofu Wrap

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)
Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

steps: Crumble the tofu into a nonstick pan with the oil and cook 3 to 4 minutes over medium-low.
Stir in the cream, turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper.
Add the diced tomato and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Warm the tortilla, fill it with the tofu and serve with the dressed salad.

title: Skyr and Berry Smoothie Bowl

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Blend the skyr, frozen berries, vanilla and honey until thick and smooth (a few drops of water if needed).
Pour into a bowl and top with the almonds and granola.

title: Skyr Cheesecake-Style

lines.food: Applesauce, canned, unsweetened, without added ascorbic acid (includes USDA commodity)
Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Crush the cookies into crumbs, mix with the coconut oil and applesauce and press into the bottom of a jar or ramekin.
Whisk the skyr, honey and lemon juice until smooth and spread it over the base.
Chill at least 3 hours. A little lemon zest on top is nice.

title: Smoked Salmon and Plant-Based Yogurt Toast

lines.food: Plant-based yogurt alternative, made from soya, unsweetened

steps: Toast the bread and let it cool a minute.
Spread with the yogurt, add the smoked salmon, then cucumber slices and dill.

title: Smoked Tofu and Leek Fondue

lines.food: Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)

steps: Brown the cubed smoked tofu in the oil over medium-high heat, 5 to 7 minutes.
In another pan, cook the sliced leeks until soft, 6 to 8 minutes, with a splash of water if needed.
Stir the cream and curry powder into the leeks, add the tofu and season.

title: Speculoos Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything with an ice cube or two until smooth.
Thin with water if needed and drink right away.

title: Beef Patty with Fried Eggs and Carrot Salad

lines.food: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Heat the oil in a nonstick pan. Cook the beef patty on one side and fry the eggs on the other, 4 to 6 minutes a side for the patty. Season.
Toss the grated carrot with the greens, dressing and crumbled feta.
Serve the patty topped with the eggs, with the salad on the side.

title: Summer Quinoa and Chicken Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil until done and season.
Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper, and toss everything together.

title: Summer Salad with Plant-Based Chunks and Quinoa

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool.
Brown the plant-based chunks in the oil and season.
Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper, and toss everything together.

title: Sweet Potato and Chestnut Gratin
steps: Heat the oven to 390°F (200°C).
Microwave the sweet potato cubes with a splash of water, covered, 5 minutes. Drain.
Put them in a baking dish with the chestnuts, sliced mushrooms and diced ham.
Stir in the sour cream, season, top with the cheese and bake 20 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato and Pork Blanquette

lines.t: 1.5 tbsp lactose-free light sour cream (24 g)

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Pork, fresh, loin, tenderloin, separable lean only, raw
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Dice the onion, sweet potato and pork; slice the carrot and mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in a nonstick pot and set aside. Cook the onion, carrot, sweet potato and pork in the oil 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the broth cube dissolved in the water and the bouquet garni. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, adding water if needed.
Stir the flour into the sour cream, add it to the pot and stir until thick. Return the mushrooms for 5 minutes and season.

title: Tropical Chicken and Mango Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the quinoa 10 to 12 minutes, then rinse cold and drain.
Cook the chicken in the oil 6 to 7 minutes a side until done, then slice.
Toss the lettuce, quinoa, diced mango, halved tomatoes and corn.
Add the chicken and cilantro, drizzle with the vinegar, season and toss gently.

title: Tuna Rillettes and Tomato Toast

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 2 tbsp lactose-free light sour cream (30 g)
80 g (2.75 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Toast the bread.
Mix the flaked tuna with the sour cream, salt and pepper.
Spread mustard on the toast, then the tuna and halved tomatoes. Finish with a drizzle of oil.

title: Tuna Rillettes with Carrot Sticks

lines.food: Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)

lines.t: 300 g (10.5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Mix the drained tuna with the mustard, lemon juice and cream. Season.
Serve with carrot sticks to dip.

title: Tuna Stuffed Avocado

lines.t: 100 g (3.5 oz) canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Halve and pit the avocado.
Mix the tuna with the yogurt and lemon juice.
Scoop out a little avocado to make room, pile in the tuna and eat any extra on the side.

title: Turkey-Stuffed Omelet

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour into the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Put the turkey and grated cheese on one half, fold over and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until melted.
Serve with the halved tomatoes dressed in balsamic.

title: Turmeric Ginger Lemon Apple Smoothie
steps: Core and chop the apples and peel the ginger.
Blend with the lemon juice, honey and an ice cube or two, adding water until it pours. Drink right away.

title: Vanilla Banana Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything (frozen banana or a couple of ice cubes) until smooth.
Thin with water if needed.

title: Vegan Banana Matcha Protein Smoothie

lines.t: 1 tbsp plant plant protein powder (9 g)
305 ml (10.25 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

steps: Blend the plant milk, protein powder, matcha and banana until smooth (frozen banana or ice for a colder shake).
Pour into a glass and top with the sliced almonds.

title: Vegan Chickpea Flour Spinach Omelette

lines.food: Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)

steps: Whisk the chickpea flour with the cream and enough water for a smooth batter. Season.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the oil, 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour the batter over the spinach, lower the heat and cook undisturbed 5 to 8 minutes until the top is no longer runny.
Flip and cook 3 to 5 minutes more until golden and firm. Serve with the toast.

title: Vegan Chunk and Cheddar Baguette

lines.food: Bread, french or vienna, whole wheat
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Plant-based cheese alternative, vegetable fat based, vegan
Plant-based soft cream cheese alternative, almond-based, vegan

steps: Brown the plant-based chunks in a nonstick pan and season.
Split the baguette and spread both sides with the vegan cream cheese.
Layer tomato slices and the vegan cheddar, then the chunks, and close.
Serve with cucumber sticks.

title: Vegan Quiche with Tomato Salad

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Tofu, soft, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
Plant-based cheese alternative, vegetable fat based, vegan

lines.t: 37 ml (1.25 fl oz) unsweetened soy milk

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Rehydrate the TVP in hot water and drain.
Blitz the oats into a coarse flour and mix with the melted margarine, half the tofu and a pinch of salt into a dough.
Press into a small greased dish, prick with a fork and bake 8 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the tofu with the milk, then stir in the TVP, cheese, herbs, salt and pepper.
Pour into the crust and bake 15 to 20 minutes until set. Serve with sliced tomato.

title: Vegan Zucchini Fritters with Spinach

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Tofu, soft, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Plant-based soft cream cheese alternative, almond-based, vegan

steps: Grate the zucchini and squeeze out as much water as you can in a clean towel.
Mix with chopped spinach, the vegan cream cheese, dill, tofu, sliced green onion and garlic.
Stir in the almond flour and baking powder.
Fry spoonfuls in the olive oil over medium heat, flattening them, 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden.
Drain on paper towel and serve warm.

title: Vegetable Lasagna with Ham

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin strips.
Season the tomato sauce with oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Layer zucchini, sauce and ham in a small dish, repeat, and finish with zucchini and the mozzarella.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Vegetable Lentil Salad

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt
Plant-based cream alternative, made from soya (for boiling and refining)
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Drain the chickpeas, lentils and corn.
Combine them with the edamame and grated carrot.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and cream, pour over and toss.
Season and finish with parsley.

title: Vegetarian Bean Sauté

lines.t: 200 g (7 oz) canned red kidney beans, drained
lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Cook the diced pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the beans, corn, garlic powder and tomato sauce and heat through, about 5 minutes.
Serve on the toast.

title: Vegetarian Gnocchi with Plant-Based Strips and Leeks
steps: Slice the leek and chop the onion.
Soften them in the oil 5 to 7 minutes, with a splash of water if they catch.
Add the plant-based chunks and brown 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in the gnocchi for 2 to 3 minutes, then the sour cream. Season and serve.

title: White Omelet with Salmon and Sautéed Zucchini

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Sauté the zucchini in the oil until tender.
Dice the smoked salmon.
Separate the egg; beat the whites to stiff peaks, then fold in the yolk, a pinch of pepper and the salmon.
Spread in a lightly oiled nonstick pan over low-medium heat, cover and cook about 5 minutes until set.
Serve with the zucchini and toast.

title: Whole Grain Toast with Cottage Cheese and Honey or Agave
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with the cottage cheese and drizzle with honey or agave.

title: Winter Mug Cake with Cinnamon and Applesauce Center

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Applesauce, canned, unsweetened, without added ascorbic acid (includes USDA commodity)

steps: Mix everything except 1 tablespoon of the applesauce.
Pour half the batter into a mug, add the reserved applesauce in the middle and cover with the rest.
Microwave about 1½ minutes.

title: Yogurt and Matcha Smoothie

lines.food: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend the yogurt, milk, matcha, banana and honey until smooth (frozen banana makes it creamier).

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto and Turkey Slices

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Spiralize or peel the zucchini into noodles. Blanch 2 to 3 minutes if you like, or leave raw.
Add halved tomatoes and torn mozzarella.
Toss with the pesto, season, and serve with the turkey.
